summary: Lesaka Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an extension of the outside date under a Transaction Implementation Agreement dated June 26, 2025, whereby its subsidiary Lesaka Technologies Proprietary Limited agreed to acquire Bank Zero Mutual Bank and related entities. The outside date for fulfilling or waiving conditions precedent was extended from August 6, 2026 to January 31, 2027, pending outstanding regulatory consents. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. This filing is a material-definitive-agreement update typical of an acquisition extension. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and any risk-arb spread if a price was previously announced.
